title: Tech Note: Automating Form Changes in Project Mode
author: Erick Lui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: FORM GET NAMES / GET TABLE TITLES

historical_commentary.text: Still fully valid: project-mode forms are indeed plain JSON (.4DForm) files, and directly parsing/patching them with JSON Parse/JSON Stringify remains a completely current, supported technique for bulk form edits.
related_updates: Project mode (introduced v17-18) stores every form as a .4DForm JSON file exactly as described; this hasn't changed, so the bulk-editing technique shown here is directly applicable to current 4D versions.

This kind of scripted form migration is especially relevant to organizations doing (or having done) the binary-to-project-mode conversion, complementing tools like the Conversion Assistant component (TN 22-03).
